output.creation_rule: create only after explicit Phase-B authorization; fail if this identity path already contains run outputs

candidate_feature_artifacts.materialization_rule: create after explicit authorization as the first model-contact operation; fail if any destination already exists; preserve partial-attempt artifacts under a distinct failed-attempt identity

arms.B-DUP: anchor feature receives its anchor target again
arms.B-MATCHED: radius-matched neutral feature receives the anchor target
arms.B-SHAM: certified sham feature receives the anchor target

model_and_representation.pooling: final-layer mean_full over valid token positions

candidate_feature_extraction.text_serialization: name + U+2014 EM DASH + one space + description; UTF-8 bytes exactly, no normalization
candidate_feature_extraction.ordering: lexicographic candidate_semantic_id; preserve all 48 rows without deduplication
candidate_feature_extraction.tokenization: pinned tokenizer files from the local model snapshot; add_special_tokens=true; padding=false; truncation=true; max_length=1024; production batch_size=1
candidate_feature_extraction.truncation_disposition: if any candidate input would be truncated, abort before feature tensor acceptance; do not alter text or length policy
candidate_feature_extraction.token_length_receipt: record per-candidate token count and min/median/p95/max before extraction, then bind those counts to the feature receipt
required_checks_before_head_initializati: 48 ordered semantic IDs and text hashes match the manifest
verify the pinned local snapshot file hashes and tokenizer identity before loading; network access is disabled
write a token-length receipt for all 48 rows and abort if any would be truncated
tensor dtype is float32 and all values are finite
feature receipt binds model revision, snapshot file hashes, extractor hash, extraction settings, input-manifest hash, token-length receipt hash, tensor hash, and file hash
persist the tensor and receipts at the exact output paths declared in output.candidate_feature_artifacts; independently verify hashes before making them readable to trainers
candidate_feature_extraction.mismatch_disposition: ABORT_BEFORE_HEAD_TRAINING; no candidate replacement or alternate extraction recipe

head_input_and_architecture.head: dynamic_mlp_compatibility
parameters: concatenate state, candidate, elementwise product, and absolute difference (512 values)
head_input_and_architecture.input_transform: raw float32 frozen features; no feature normalization, centering, or scaling
head_input_and_architecture.candidate_order_training_transform: reverse candidate indices and target values together for every primary and auxiliary row, matching fast_tensor_batch(reorder=true)
head_input_and_architecture.candidate_mask: four true candidates per row; no padding candidates; any violation aborts
head_input_and_architecture.output: four logits; closed-set softmax in canonical semantic-ID alignment

common_primary_occurrence_manifest.occurrence_identity: occurrence_index plus group_id; exact immutable order

B-DUP.layout: 10000 common primary occurrences followed by 5000 auxiliary occurrences

B-MATCHED.layout: 10000 common primary occurrences followed by 5000 auxiliary occurrences

B-SHAM.layout: 10000 common primary occurrences followed by 5000 auxiliary occurrences

resolved_feature_contract.state_feature_map: training-only scope index -> one 2048-dimensional raw float32 state feature; source episode ID and input hash must resolve exactly
resolved_feature_contract.candidate_feature_map: candidate index -> one of the 48 name_definition candidate features; each feature is 2048-dimensional raw float32
resolved_feature_contract.per_event_candidate_indices: four indices in the sealed semantic candidate order; all four masks true
resolved_feature_contract.target_alignment: four target probabilities remain paired to their candidate semantic IDs through the frozen reverse-order batch transform
resolved_feature_contract.auxiliary_target_source: the anchor target for the same neighborhood in all three arms
resolved_feature_contract.feature_normalization: none; model receives raw float32 state and candidate features
resolved_feature_contract.candidate_tensor_acceptance: 48x2048 contiguous finite float32; exact manifest/catalog/text/model/extractor hashes; no truncation

training_surface_audit.scope: 5000 training anchor/matched-neutral pairs and 5000 training anchor/certified-sham pairs; training-only feature-scope text
training_surface_audit.interpretation_limit: surface edit magnitude and serialization size are matched; changed field identity and position relative to the fact-bearing line are not matched and remain part of the treatment contrast

head_input_and_architecture.head_input_manifest_contract: for every primary and auxiliary event, resolve state feature by feature_scope_index; resolve candidate features by candidate_indices in row order; pair target values with those IDs; preserve all four true mask values; source and target hashes must match sealed arm manifest

training.paired_initialization: one seed-initialized CompatibilityHead template per seed; byte-identical state loaded into all three arms
training.initialization_procedure: for each seed, initialize Python and torch CPU/CUDA RNGs to that seed, instantiate CompatibilityHead(2048, 'mlp', 128) using the frozen implementation on the pinned device, save one immutable CPU state-dict template and SHA-256, then load that exact template into each arm before creating a fresh AdamW optimizer; verify all three initial state hashes are identical
training.rng_reset_per_arm: Python, torch CPU, and all CUDA generators reset to the paired seed before each arm; no dropout or stochastic augmentation
training.concurrency: one run process at a time; no concurrent training runs

data_pipeline.sampler: none; consume the immutable schedule directly
data_pipeline.auxiliary_events: append the scheduled auxiliary events to the current primary minibatch; do not make separate optimizer updates

primary_per_epoch.order: use the exact occurrence indices in the schedule; do not reshuffle at runtime

auxiliary_per_epoch.reuse_across_epochs: the same 5000 auxiliary manifest rows are each exposed exactly once in each epoch; 15000 auxiliary loss-event exposures per complete 3-epoch run
auxiliary_per_epoch.schedule_slot_semantics: each auxiliary_anchor_batch_slots value is a zero-based anchor ordinal in the common primary manifest; the corresponding primary anchor occurrence index is exactly 2*slot, and the value resolves to the auxiliary row at auxiliary_manifest_offset + slot in each arm manifest
auxiliary_per_epoch.schedule_order: auxiliary_anchor_batch_slots are listed in the same order as the anchor occurrences appear within that schedule row's primary_occurrence_indices; each slot must resolve to that anchor's auxiliary target/source row
auxiliary_per_epoch.source_mapping: the fixed arm-specific source episode in the corresponding head-input manifest; DUP uses the anchor source, MATCHED uses its sealed radius-matched neutral, SHAM uses its certified sham
auxiliary_per_epoch.schedule_counts: 40 optimizer batches per epoch; each schedule row contains up to 256 primary occurrences plus exactly one auxiliary event for each anchor occurrence in that row; final primary batch contains 16 rows; sum of auxiliary slots is 5000 per epoch

batch_and_loss_execution.forward_row_order: primary rows first in schedule order, followed by their auxiliary rows in auxiliary-slot order
batch_and_loss_execution.candidate_order_transform: reverse candidate IDs and target values together for every row before head scoring, as fast_tensor_batch(reorder=true); no random candidate permutation
batch_and_loss_execution.loss_reduction: one v05_loss call over the concatenated primary-then-auxiliary event batch; per-event categorical cross-entropy plus 0.25 multiclass Brier; arithmetic mean over all active events in that optimizer step
batch_and_loss_execution.step_formula: (N_base*L_base + N_aux*L_aux)/(N_base + N_aux), with unit event weights and no masked auxiliary losses

loss.per_event: mean categorical cross-entropy plus 0.25 times mean multiclass Brier score

training.checkpoint_policy: save after each epoch; epoch 3 is the sole primary endpoint; retain all 27 checkpoints; no best-epoch selection
training.crash_policy: for an infrastructure/process failure only, retain failed-attempt artifacts and restart the affected seed-arm run from epoch zero with the same frozen seed and contract; no seed replacement and no resume; any contract/hash mismatch, non-finite loss/gradient, or implementation-semantic discrepancy halts the full experiment for review and is not an infrastructure retry

runtime_environment.runtime_mismatch_disposition: ABORT_BEFORE_MODEL_LOAD; do not silently substitute hardware or software

readable: sealed training state-feature cache and scope receipt
pinned local model snapshot for candidate extraction only
candidate model-input manifest during extraction only
validated candidate-features.pt and its candidate-feature-receipt.json and candidate-token-lengths.json
training_process_filesystem_scope.candidate_extractor_scope: candidate text manifest plus pinned local model/tokenizer snapshot only; no training or evaluation rows
training_process_filesystem_scope.trainer_candidate_feature_scope: after extraction receipt validation, trainers may read the candidate tensor and its receipts, but may not read the candidate text manifest, tokenizer, model snapshot, or any evaluation path

opening_order: candidate feature extraction and validation; no head initialization until it passes
complete all nine runs and seal all 27 epoch checkpoints plus training telemetry
unlock the held-out matched-panel-v02 exactly once for frozen terminal inference
